text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. 5. Transcript of postgraduate school 6. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents.
